title: Charred Vegetable Kebabs with Piquant Sauce
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Chinese-inspired dish featuring charred vegetables and a tangy piquant sauce. Perfect for a quick dinner or lunch.

ingredients.name: Charred vegetables (such as bell peppers, onions, and mushrooms)

instructions: Thread zucchini and charred vegetables onto skewers.
Brush kebabs with piquant sauce and season with salt and pepper.
Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Serve hot with additional piquant sauce for dipping.
